_note: PROVISIONAL. Permission questions for shell commands and file edits during the baseline, and the keys that allow ONCE (normal use: the user approves each action; nothing is allowed permanently, so the clients' stores do not change between cycles). To be confirmed in exploratory set-up sessions (baseline_session.py --setup) and frozen, with this file's SHA-256, before the first baseline session. MCP tool approvals and the ready patterns come from tool-change/scripts/q3-clients.json (frozen for Q3). A question that matches no pattern but looks like a permission question is answered with the preselected option and recorded as unexpected (as D19 does for Q3).

claude-code.allow: Do you want to proceed\?|Do you want to make this edit|Do you want to create

codex.allow: Would you like to run the following command\?|Would you like to make the following edits\?|Allow command\?

qwen.allow: Allow execution of|Apply this change\?|Yes, allow once

cursor-agent.allow: Run this command\?|Accept this edit|Apply this change

_generic: Do you want to|Allow|Approve|\(y/n\)|\[y/N\]|Yes, allow once|Proceed\?
